dashboard.name: Lending
dashboard.description: The loan book: what was disbursed, what is outstanding, and what is at risk. PAR30 follows the microfinance convention so it is comparable with how the sector reports.

cards.name: Portfolio at risk (PAR30) by disbursement month
cards.description: Share of outstanding principal more than 30 days past due.
cards.sql:
select disbursement_month, country_iso3, par30_pct
from mart_loan_performance
order by disbursement_month

cards.name: Principal disbursed by month
cards.description: Lending volume over time, all countries combined.
cards.sql:
select disbursement_month, sum(principal_disbursed_usd) as principal_usd, sum(loans_disbursed) as loans
from mart_loan_performance
group by disbursement_month
order by disbursement_month

cards.name: Loan book by country
cards.description: Disbursed, repaid, outstanding and at-risk balances per country.
cards.sql:
with by_country as (
    select country_iso3,
           sum(loans_disbursed)         as loans_disbursed,
           sum(principal_disbursed_usd) as principal_usd,
           sum(repaid_usd)              as repaid_usd,
           sum(outstanding_usd)         as outstanding_usd,
           sum(at_risk_usd)             as at_risk_usd,
           sum(loans_written_off)       as written_off
    from mart_loan_performance
    group by country_iso3
)
select country_iso3,
       loans_disbursed,
       round(principal_usd, 2)   as principal_usd,
       round(repaid_usd, 2)      as repaid_usd,
       round(outstanding_usd, 2) as outstanding_usd,
       round(if(outstanding_usd > 0, at_risk_usd / outstanding_usd * 100, 0), 2) as par30_pct,
       written_off
from by_country
order by principal_usd desc

cards.name: Repayment punctuality by country
cards.description: On-time rate and how much of it arrives by mobile money.
cards.sql:
select country_iso3, on_time_rate_pct, mobile_money_share_pct, avg_days_late_when_late
from mart_repayment_performance
order by on_time_rate_pct desc
